epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce false positive project stagnation warnings from 1 to 0
requirements: R1: Patch the deliverable and feature readiness calculation logic to correctly count resolved items and clear the stagnation warning

slices.title: Fix deliverable readiness stagnation calculation
slices.jtbd: When implementing the calculation fix for this epic, I want to accurately count resolved deliverables, so that the stagnation warning is correctly dismissed.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a project state with newly resolved deliverables
When the deliverable readiness metric is calculated
Then the resolved items are accurately counted in the progress metric
Then the false stagnation deadlock warning is cleared
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce calculation errors of resolved deliverables from 1 to 0

slices.title: Verify deliverable readiness calculation fix
slices.jtbd: When implementing QA for this epic, I want to verify the readiness calculation across the test pyramid, so that the stagnation bug is proven resolved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the updated calculation logic for deliverable readiness
When integration and E2E tests are executed for the project observer
Then unit tests verify the correct counting of resolved items
Then E2E tests verify the stagnation warning is not shown when progress exists
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce uncaught calculation regressions from 1 to 0
